menu.title: ELIZA
menu.subtitle: Weizenbaum's 1966 program with the scripts that exist in the source repository, and one script for the mesh. It runs in your browser. Type *help in any script to see the commands.
menu.about: The recreation of ELIZA by Anthony and Max Hay. The box downloads it from github.com/anthay/ELIZA. adapt_eliza.py adapts it. Each entry opens eliza.html?script=NAME. The banner is the banner in its source (eliza.cpp, eliza.html).

entries.name: DOCTOR, 1966
entries.desc: The DOCTOR script as printed in the January 1966 CACM paper. Type *cacm to replay the conversation in the paper

entries.name: DOCTOR, 1965 (MIT archive, tape 100)
entries.desc: The earlier DOCTOR script, from a listing printed on 6 March 1965 in the papers of Weizenbaum

entries.name: DOCTOR on the mesh
entries.desc: The 1965 DOCTOR with the box's own keywords: mesh, node, LoRa, antenna, battery, firmware, signal

entries.name: DOCTOR, 1965 (tape 102), as printed
entries.desc: The other script in that listing. It does not run as printed because one line is out of place. ELIZA shows where

entries.name: DOCTOR en français
entries.desc: The 1966 DOCTOR translated for the Jeu de Paume's 2025 exhibition, Le monde selon l'IA

entries.name: YAPYAP
entries.desc: From a 1965 pilot study by Quarton, McGuire and Lorch, adapted to run on 1966 ELIZA

entries.name: YAPYAP, as printed
entries.desc: The script of the study before adaptation. It needs features that ELIZA of 1966 does not have. It does not run

entries.name: Turing machine: equal As and Bs
entries.desc: ELIZA as a Turing machine. Type EQUAL A B B A (answer: YES). Type EQUAL A A A B B (answer: NO)

entries.name: Turing machine: palindromes
entries.desc: Type PALP A B B A (answer: TRUE). Type PALP A A A B B (answer: FALSE)

entries.name: Turing's Example I (1936)
entries.desc: Computes 010101… as in On Computable Numbers. It never stops. Type *tracepre to watch the tape. Then type EX1. Type *maxtran 0 to remove the limit of 500 steps. Press Escape to stop it

entries.name: Turing's Example II (1936)
entries.desc: Computes 001011011101111… It never stops. Type *tracepre. Then type EX2. Type *maxtran 0 to remove the limit of 500 steps. Press Escape to stop it

addon.title: ELIZA (rule-based chatbot)
addon.summary: Weizenbaum's 1966 ELIZA, with the scripts of the source repository and a few Irate-Box keywords. The source is github.com/anthay/ELIZA, at the commit that this hub pins. It runs in the browser of the visitor. It uses about 250 KB of storage. It has no service on the box.
addon.consent: This downloads ELIZA from github.com/anthay/ELIZA, where its authors publish it. The commit is pinned. The hub then serves it to every device on the network of the box. The browser of the visitor runs it. Some scripts do not have an open licence. The 1966 DOCTOR is copyright ACM. The French translation is based on it. YAPYAP is reproduced with the permission of the Harold Garfinkel Archive. This download does not give you the right to redistribute these scripts. Add ELIZA?
